Execute the acquired semantic reading operations on the CURRENT
source windows. All operation meanings, alternatives and examples are learned
assets, not current-source facts. Classify the operation's actual question;
do not answer a downstream task or copy an old example's choice. Preserve who
acts, the legal modality, trigger, scope and qualifications. A heading, mention
or hypothetical event is not automatically an operative duty or permission.
Return exactly one answer for every supplied query ID. Select a declared choice
or "unknown". Missing information is unknown, never an implicit negative.
Return {"answers": {query_id: {"choice": choice, "evidence_unit_ids": [unit_id]}}}.
Select the IDs of the current supplied units that support your classification.
The host retrieves those units exactly. Do not copy, rewrite or repair quotes.
Select all units needed to resolve actors, conditions and cross-references.
Every definite classification needs supporting units. Only an explicitly
declared alternative meaning absence after inspecting the complete supplied
source may have no supporting unit. Unknown may have no evidence. Demonstration
quotes belong to their original sources, never the current source. No extra IDs
or fields. Selecting a unit does not make its interpretation automatically true.
The focus_unit_id identifies the clause to classify. Other supplied units are context for resolving its references, not additional effects to merge into that focus. Interpret the acquired operation for that focus clause, using its actual context.

{"operations": [{"choices": [{"meaning": "该单元直接创设对明确接收者类别的披露许可或限定访问许可。", "name": "operative_class_permission"}, {"meaning": "该单元直接禁止向其所述接收者类别披露，且本单元没有嵌入类别许可。", "name": "operative_general_prohibition"}, {"meaning": "该单元以一般禁止为主，同时以 except 或同等结构明确许可一个受限接收者类别。", "name": "prohibition_with_embedded_class_permission"}, {"meaning": "该单元不是可执行的披露许可或禁止，包括定义、事实叙述、标题或无法由本窗口解决的文本。", "name": "not_an_operative_disclosure_rule"}], "examples": [{"choice": "operative_general_prohibition", "quote": "(a) not to, directly or indirectly, in any way, disclose, make accessible, reveal, report, publish, disseminate or transfer any Confidential Information to any third party;", "source": "ContractNLI:4d4e550ac17660215ea791c0b3a37cbef136c2e7642e6cbeb3cc9a3df43eeb40"}, {"choice": "operative_class_permission", "quote": "(c) to restrict access to Confidential Information to those of its officers, directors and employees who have a legitimate need-to-know to carry out the Purpose and who are obligated to protect such Confidential Information pursuant to terms and conditions no less protective of Discloser than those contained in this Agreement; and", "source": "ContractNLI:4d4e550ac17660215ea791c0b3a37cbef136c2e7642e6cbeb3cc9a3df43eeb40"}, {"choice": "prohibition_with_embedded_class_permission", "quote": "(c) not to disclose the same whether to its employees or to third parties except in confidence to such of its employees, directors or contractors who need to know the same for the Purpose and that (i) such employees, directors and contractors are obliged by their contracts of employment or services not to disclose the same, (ii) the receiving party shall enforce such obligations at its expense and at the request of the disclosing party in so far as breach thereof relates to the disclosing party's Confidential Information;", "source": "ContractNLI:d9360f2a8c03efc35524289167a83e9505ebae476367505b868af29f37fcffa0"}], "name": "disclosure_modality", "question": "仅根据最后一个单元并结合窗口中的前文，判断该单元是否创设可执行的披露规则。区分直接类别许可、一般禁止，以及在禁止中明确嵌入类别许可的结构；定义、叙述和未解决交叉引用不得当作许可。"}], "current_queries": [{"id": "disclosure_modality|unit|42", "operation": "disclosure_modality", "unit_ids": [42], "current_units": [{"id": 42, "text": "(k) Make sure that all the employees and/or consultants engaged to undertake any audit on its behalf have signed the mandatory non-disclosure agreement."}], "focus_unit_id": 42}, {"id": "disclosure_modality|unit|62", "operation": "disclosure_modality", "unit_ids": [62], "current_units": [{"id": 62, "text": "Auditor shall restrict disclosure of such Confidential Information to its employees and/or consultants with a need to know (and advise such employees and/or consultants of the obligations assumed herein), shall use the Confidential Information only for the purposes set forth in the Agreement, and shall not disclose such Confidential Information to any affiliates, subsidiaries, associates and/or third party without prior written approval of the Auditee."}], "focus_unit_id": 62}]}
